model_note: Official docs describe this API name as serving DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the models endpoint returned deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro.

knowledge_result.path: initial equals/hashCode error -> HashMap bucket correction -> Redis mechanism -> MySQL B+ tree and covering-index boundary
knowledge_result.finding: The model identified the wrong claim, accepted the correction, and changed the next question from the answer.

project_result.path: metric attribution -> colleague-owned Redis boundary -> index design -> hypothetical boundary after missing records
project_result.finding: The model kept project claims separate from knowledge evidence and treated missing records as uncertainty rather than proof of fabrication.

limitations: Synthetic candidate, not human speech or independent human grading.
One scenario per track; no p95 or repeated randomized runs.
Cloud semantic decisions are too slow for direct per-turn real-time speech without a fast draft model or prefetch.
A model can produce a plausible but wrong assessment; evidence and schema validation do not replace expert review.
